toy.text: The man with a gun is a kid with a plastic water pistol, orange tip and all. His mother arrives at a run.

options.text: Explain to both of them how close that was.

gun.text: A man in the courtyard with his hand at his waistband, scanning the windows. The 911 caller is on the line saying he's got a gun.

phone.text: A man pacing the courtyard, shouting into something black in his hand. It could be a phone.

failure.note: You can't tell, and he's coming toward you.

phone_look.text: It's a phone. He's fighting with his landlord about an eviction. He has no idea anyone called the police.

options.text: Tell him what the caller said, and let him go.

success.note: He goes pale. Then he thanks you.
